summary: Seasonal landing page for CPA firms (6,000px): an oversized head with a portrait and an overlapping offer form, four staggered benefit cards, a staff-profile card with a task list, a hire block with a monthly rate, reasons with an ISO badge and a dark contact block.

sections.note: peach ground; left: small tag, huge title with orange words, a lead and one button; right: cutout portrait on an orange blob; an orange offer strip with an inline form (name, email, button) overlaps the bottom edge.
centered heading with an orange word and a line; four white raised cards with a numbered orange circle, a bold title and a line, staggered up and down in two columns
portrait photo left; right a white raised card with heading, a note, an 11-item bullet list of forms and tasks, and an orange pill button
left: a line of text, a very large monthly rate, a small saving note, a black button and a text link for hourly start; right: a second portrait on an orange blob
heading, four reasons in 2 by 2 and an ISO badge right
dark rounded block with an orange swirl: heading with an accent word and a line left; white form card right with a request / schedule switch
